## Funding and awards

```{r}
#| output: asis
cv_web_tarjetas(c(
  lapply(web("funding"), function(e) cv_web_tarjeta(
    "coins", paste("Funding ·", cv_periodo(substr(e$start, 1, 4), substr(e$end %||% "", 1, 4))),
    paste0(sprintf("**%s** %s, %s (%s), %s. *%s*", e$name, e$code %||% "", e$funder,
                   e$funder_short %||% "", e$country, e$project %||% ""),
           if (!is.null(e$extension)) paste0(" ", cv_punto(e$extension))),
    nota = e$amount
  )),
  lapply(web("awards"), function(e) cv_web_tarjeta(
    "award", paste("Award ·", cv_periodo(e$date)),
    cv_punto(paste0("**", e$title, "**", if (!is.null(e$context)) paste(" at the", e$context)))
  ))
))
```

## Research projects

```{r}
#| output: asis
hitos <- vapply(web("projects"), function(e) {
  paste0("::: cv-hito\n",
         "[", cv_periodo(e$start, e$end), "]{.cv-fecha}\n\n",
         "[", e$title, "]{.cv-puesto}\n\n",
         "[", sprintf("%s (%s), %s · PI: %s", e$funder, e$code, e$country, e$pi), "]{.cv-lugar}\n\n",
         cv_punto(e$role), " Budget: ", e$amount, ".\n",
         ":::\n")
}, "")
cat("::: cv-linea\n", paste(hitos, collapse = "\n"), ":::\n", sep = "")
```

For the projects I lead, see [Funding and awards](#funding-and-awards).

## Student supervision

```{r}
#| output: asis
hitos <- vapply(web("supervision"), function(e) {
  paste0("::: cv-hito\n",
         "[", cv_periodo(e$start, e$end, compacto = TRUE), "]{.cv-fecha}\n\n",
         "[", paste(c(e$role, e$at), collapse = " "), "]{.cv-puesto}\n\n",
         "[", paste(c(e$student, e$program, e$institution, if (!is.null(e$hours)) paste(e$hours, "h")), collapse = " · "), "]{.cv-lugar}\n",
         if (!is.null(e$cosupervisor)) paste0("\nCo-supervised with ", e$cosupervisor, ".\n") else "",
         ":::\n")
}, "")
cat("::: cv-linea\n", paste(hitos, collapse = "\n"), ":::\n", sep = "")
```

## Software

```{r}
#| output: asis
cv_web_tarjetas(lapply(web("software"), function(e) cv_web_tarjeta(
  "code", paste("R package ·", cv_periodo(e$date)),
  paste0("**[", e$name, "](", e$url %||% paste0("https://doi.org/", e$doi), ")**: ",
         e$title, ". R package", if (!is.null(e$version)) paste0(" version ", e$version),
         if (!is.null(e$repository)) paste0(", ", e$repository), "."),
  nota = if (!is.null(e$doi)) sprintf("DOI: [%s](https://doi.org/%s)", e$doi, e$doi)
)))
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
if (length(cv$profile$repositories)) {
  cat("**Open data and code:** ",
      paste(vapply(cv$profile$repositories, function(r) sprintf("[%s](%s)", r$name, r$url), ""),
            collapse = " · "), "\n", sep = "")
}
```

## Service to the community

```{r}
#| output: asis
cv_web_tarjetas(list(
  if (length(web("organization"))) cv_web_tarjeta(
    "calendar-check", "Event organization",
    cv_web_lista(vapply(web("organization"), function(e) {
      sprintf("%s (%s): %s", e$event, cv_periodo(e$date), tolower(e$role))
    }, ""))
  ),
  if (length(cv$editorial) || length(web("juries"))) cv_web_tarjeta(
    "book-open-reader", "Editorial and academic service",
    cv_web_lista(c(
      vapply(cv_filtrar(cv$editorial, "web"), function(e) {
        paste0(e$role, ", *", e$journal, "*", if (!is.null(e$description)) paste0(" (", e$description, ")"))
      }, ""),
      vapply(web("juries"), function(e) {
        sprintf("PhD jury member: PhD defence of %s, %s (%s)", e$candidate, e$university, cv_periodo(e$date))
      }, "")
    ))
  ),
  if (length(web("outreach"))) cv_web_tarjeta(
    "bullhorn", "Outreach and citizen science",
    vapply(web("outreach"), function(e) {
      nombre <- if (is.null(e$url)) e$title else sprintf("[%s](%s)", e$title, e$url)
      cv_punto(sprintf("%s of **%s** (%s), a %s", e$role, nombre, cv_periodo(e$date), e$description))
    }, "")
  ),
  if (length(cv$reviews)) cv_web_tarjeta(
    "eye", "Peer review",
    cv_punto(paste(vapply(cv$reviews, function(r) sprintf("*%s* (%s)", r$journal, r$count), ""),
                   collapse = ", "))
  ),
  if (length(web("memberships"))) cv_web_tarjeta(
    "users", "Memberships",
    vapply(web("memberships"), function(e) {
      nombre <- if (is.null(e$url)) e$name else sprintf("[%s](%s)", e$name, e$url)
      paste0(paste(c(nombre, e$full_name, e$role), collapse = ", "),
             " (since ", e$since, ").\n")
    }, "")
  ),
  if (length(web("workshops"))) cv_web_tarjeta(
    "people-group", "Workshops",
    vapply(web("workshops"), function(e) {
      cv_punto(paste0(if (!is.null(e$role)) paste(e$role, "in "), "**", e$title, "**",
                      if (!is.null(e$description)) paste0(": ", e$description),
                      " (", cv_periodo(e$date), ")"))
    }, "")
  )
))
```

## Training, skills and languages

```{r}
#| output: asis
habilidades <- unlist(lapply(cv$skills$technical, function(g) g$items))
cv_web_tarjetas(list(
  cv_web_tarjeta(
    "graduation-cap", "Courses",
    cv_web_lista(vapply(web("courses"), function(e) {
      paste0(e$title, if (!is.null(e$org)) paste0(", ", e$org), " (", cv_periodo(e$date), ")")
    }, ""))
  ),
  cv_web_tarjeta(
    "screwdriver-wrench", "Skills",
    paste0("::: cv-chips\n", paste(sprintf("[%s]{.cv-chip}", habilidades), collapse = " "), "\n:::")
  ),
  cv_web_tarjeta(
    "language", "Languages",
    paste(vapply(cv$skills$languages, function(l) {
      sprintf("**%s**: %s", l$language, cv_nivel_idioma(l$level, l$label))
    }, ""), collapse = "<br>")
  ),
  cv_web_tarjeta(
    "address-book", "References",
    cv_web_lista(vapply(web("references"), function(r) {
      sprintf("**%s** — %s, %s", r$name, r$role, r$org_short %||% r$org)
    }, "")),
    nota = "Contact details in the [PDF](cv.pdf) or on request."
  )
))
```
